svg.title: 海洋热浪识别示意 / Marine heatwave detection schematic
svg.desc: 连续八天超过季节性第九十百分位阈值，满足至少五天的热浪定义。 / Eight consecutive days exceed the seasonal 90th-percentile threshold, meeting the five-day event definition.
